page.layout: One page of text. Above the text, centred: a circular portrait medallion with the engraved label "PAVL.ÆGINETA". Below it: one paragraph of running text. Below the text: a decorative ornament, then the signature. The running head is at the top. The page number is at the top right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: PAULUS Ægineta, mirabili ardore discendi percitus, dif-ficillimas peregrinationes sustinuit, ut medicam artem cognoscere. Libros reliquit in medicina, non sua inventione, sed Galeni imitatione, cuius veluti simia dici potest. A Ioanne filio Serapionis allegatur simpliciter Pauli nomine, & similiter ab aliis Medicis. Scripsit lib. 7. Græcos, collatione vetustorum exemplariū restitutos, & quibusdam in locis auctos, per Hieronymū Gemusceum impressos Basileæ, qui fuerunt versi à Ioane Guinterio Andernaco, & ab Albano Tornio, quos prior commentariis illustravit. Aeginetæ libros Henricus Stephanus, cum aliis præcipuorum medicorum libris excudit. Floruit anno mundi 4398. salutis 439.

page.notes: The medallion portrait is an engraving of Paulus Aegineta with the circular inscription "PAVL.ÆGINETA". The ornament below the text is a decorative woodcut strip with figures and scrolls and carries no text. The first line of the paragraph is set in spaced capitals, and the paragraph has no separate heading. The text is clear throughout. No doubtful readings.
